$comment: Shopify Admin API IP allowlist for the Busymate AI public app (Dev Dashboard > app > Settings > IP allowlist). This file is the source of truth: every entry here must be in the Dev Dashboard list and vice versa. A change in our egress (node move, NAT, new host) must update this file AND the Dev Dashboard BEFORE the traffic moves, or every Admin API call fails. GET /api/egress/health compares the live egress IP with this list (docs/operations/ip-allowlist.md).

entries.egress: pod SNAT to the node public IPv4; no proxy, no IPv6 in pods
callers: Deployment shopify-app (embedded admin, /mcp connector tools, webhooks, billing)
